t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advise suggested that good gnomes are the ones with 5-6 mushrooms, also I should put into consideration the colors of gnomes that perform well having in mind that the rules might change after each break.

vb_textbox.text: This is a mind game. while selecting a particular gnomes consider what color it is and how much mushrooms it collected, some colors provides much mushrooms compare to other color but if you notice that, don't dwell on it for long because the rule is likely to change. Try to be flexible with the rule when it changes.
